text:
jin (eng-release): Heads up — planning a tenant-shared indexed MV refresh + async backfill tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC. Deploybot scheduled at 03:10. Expect transient memory pressure on db-worker-2 and possible short KV eviction spikes. Need holdpoints and rollback criteria.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: migration/2026-03-21/refresh-shared-index v1 -> v2. Canary: shard-b. Post-deploy hooks: backfill-worker healthcheck, slow-query alert.

sara (eng-db): Thanks. Is the backfill idempotent? I want to know safe resume points.

jin (eng-release): Yes, it writes to tenant_index_mv_v2, then swap on commit. Backfill respects resume token in pg_metadata.backfill_cursor. Resume SQL: `SELECT cursor FROM pg_metadata WHERE key='shared_index_backfill_cursor';`

mike (eng-sre): +1 for a canary and small window. Recommend pinning app versions to avoid new query plans hitting the mv mid-backfill. Also set mem thresholds: evict if > 65% on db-worker-2.

lara (deploy-lead): We should add a deploybot holdpoint after schema apply and before swapping names. If any of the following occur rollback: >5% increase in 95p latency, >3 OOMs on db-worker, or backfill rate < 50 rows/s for 10m.

sam (product-eng): Who owns the rollback? If we abort, do we have a safe fallback to v1 and a plan to replay partial backfill?

jin (eng-release): Primary rollback owner: eng-release (me) until lara hands over post-swap. Fallback plan: revert table rename, restore `tenant_index_mv_v1` name, and trigger backfill retry from last good cursor. Steps:
```
-- 1. prevent new writes to MV
ALTER TABLE tenant_index_mv_v2 DISABLE TRIGGER ALL;
-- 2. swap names back
BEGIN; ALTER TABLE tenant_index_mv_v1 RENAME TO tenant_index_mv_tmp; ALTER TABLE tenant_index_mv_v2 RENAME TO tenant_index_mv_v1; ALTER TABLE tenant_index_mv_tmp RENAME TO tenant_index_mv_v2; COMMIT;
-- 3. re-enable triggers and resume backfill from cursor
```

mike (eng-sre): Add prometheus checks for `pg_worker_mem_bytes` and `backfill_rows_processed_total`. I'll add a dashboard tile and two alerts: mem > 70% and rows/s < 20 for 5m.

sara (eng-db): Also lock strategy: we will acquire a SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on tenant_index while swapping names; keep swap short. If locks escalate, abort and rollback.

lara (deploy-lead): Can we gate the deploybot to stop after schema apply? I want manual go/no-go to run the swap and then trigger the backfill.

deploybot: holdpoint created at step: name-swap-check (waiting for manual approval). Use `/deploy approve name-swap-check` to proceed.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet added to incident playbook: `backfill-rollback-checklist.md` (link: https://confluence/redwood/backfill-rollback-checklist)

sam (product-eng): Quick UX question — will queries see inconsistent results during the brief swap? We should prepare a release note that calls out a ~10s window of possible 0.01% inconsistency for cross-tenant joins.

jin (eng-release): Good call — adding to release notes. Also adding pin: app clients >= 3.4.1 only.

lara (deploy-lead): Final checklist for tomorrow: 1) Canary on shard-b at 03:10, 2) Verify mem alerts and dashboard, 3) Manual approve swap, 4) Monitor backfill rate for 15m, 5) If thresholds breach, run rollback steps.

mike (eng-sre): I'm on-call for the window. If I see >2 OOMs I'll suggest abort.

sara (eng-db): I'll own DB queries and will run `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_index_mv_v2 WHERE processed_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour';` during backfill.

jin (eng-release): Thanks. I'll update the deploy ticket with the checklist and add the rollback SQL. Ping me for the manual approve when ready. :thumbsup:

lara (deploy-lead): Approved on paper. Will click `/deploy approve name-swap-check` when canary looks healthy. :eyes:
